title: OpenAI Sets GPT-6.1 Sol Default Context to 500k for Codex and Work
summary:
An approximately 80% increase in the processing window has been rolled out for an AI model to help it remember more nuance during long tasks. OpenAI expanded the default context length for GPT-6.1 Sol to 500k tokens for users of Codex and ChatGPT Work, up from the previous 272k. The update reduces the frequency of data compactions, allowing the system to maintain detail and coherence over extended periods of interaction.

While 500k is the new default, users can manually override the setting to utilize a maximum context length of 1M tokens. OpenAI plans to further raise the default value in the future after testing it as a baseline for its professional user base.

Day 7/

We have increased default context length for GPT-6.1 Sol to 500k when used through Codex & Work, up from 272k or an ~ 80% increase.

We will go higher in the future, but it helps reduce occurrence of compactions and with tasks that require keeping a lot of context and nuance over periods of time. It was carefully tested and is the new sweet spot for most of our users. You can still override it if you want to be higher our lower, with maximum context length of GPT-6.1 Sol of 1M.
